definitions.explanation: To marry again after a previous marriage has ended through divorce or the death of a spouse.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{去年|きょねん}{再婚|さいこん}した。
{離婚|りこん}して{三年後|さんねんご}に{再婚|さいこん}した。
examples.english: She remarried three years after her divorce.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がいる{場合|ばあい}、{再婚|さいこん}する{際|さい}には{家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}の{気持|きも}ちを{大切|たいせつ}にする{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When there are children, it is necessary to consider the feelings of the whole family when remarrying.

notes:
A compound of {再|さい} (again; re-) and {婚|こん} (marriage). The noun form {再婚|さいこん} is equally common. In Japan, remarriage has become increasingly common and socially accepted, though it still carries some social considerations, especially when children from previous marriages are involved ({連|つ}れ{子|こ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再婚|さいこん}{相手|あいて}: remarriage partner
- {再婚|さいこん}{家庭|かてい}: remarried family; blended family
- {再婚|さいこん}を{考|かんが}える: to consider remarrying
- バツイチで{再婚|さいこん}: to remarry after one divorce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {結婚|けっこん}する: to marry — first or subsequent marriage; the general term
- {離婚|りこん}する: to divorce — the end of a marriage; often mentioned alongside {再婚|さいこん}
- {初婚|しょこん}: first marriage — contrasts with {再婚|さいこん}
